npc.dee.lines.02.speaker: dee
npc.dee.lines.02.text: I called the police. They say she's a runaway. Wren? She'd never leave her flowers.

npc.dee.lines.04.speaker: dee
npc.dee.lines.04.text: Priya at Valley Pages keeps a list. Go see her.

npc.dee.doneLines.01.speaker: dee
npc.dee.doneLines.01.text: Priya's at Valley Pages, next street over to the right. Bring Wren home, Matthew. Please.

npc.priya.lines.03.speaker: priya
npc.priya.lines.03.text: Every one of them owed Boone Holdings. Silas Boone's front company. Then come the fires, the 'accidents', the shops that sell cheap.

npc.priya.lines.04.speaker: priya
npc.priya.lines.04.text: The Foreman's crew sets the fires. Vera Lisk keeps files on anyone who talks. And the trucks go through the Rail Yards. Hank sees everything there.

npc.priya.waitLines.01.speaker: priya
npc.priya.waitLines.01.text: Sorry, we're closed early. Too many shops burning lately. Dee keeps texting about you. Talk to her first? The diner's just left of here.

npc.priya.doneLines.01.speaker: priya
npc.priya.doneLines.01.text: Hank hangs around the Rail Yards, past the gym. Don't trust a badge out there, Matthew. Not tonight.

npc.hank.lines.03.speaker: hank
npc.hank.lines.03.text: Last night they loaded spools of cable and a work order for the Mill Mountain Star. Tomorrow's the city's anniversary.

npc.hank.lines.04.speaker: hank
npc.hank.lines.04.text: He's going to black out the Star, kid. And I saw a girl with flowers on her coat in the back of that truck. They took her up the mountain.

npc.hank.waitLines.01.speaker: hank
npc.hank.waitLines.01.text: Rail yard's no place for sightseeing, kid. Patrol cars out tonight. Come back when you've got a real reason to ask.

npc.hank.doneLines.01.speaker: hank
npc.hank.doneLines.01.text: Silas Boone is up at the Star. Midnight, kid. Get your friend back before the lights go out.

npc.june.lines.01.speaker: june
npc.june.lines.01.text: Rough night? Community Center's open. Half the block sleeps here since the fires.

npc.june.lines.02.speaker: june
npc.june.lines.02.text: Drop flyers for Wren at Elmwood, or help set cots. Soft landings matter.

npc.june.lines.03.speaker: june
npc.june.lines.03.text: You're doing fine, Matthew. Come back if the city feels too dark.

npc.june.doneLines.01.speaker: june
npc.june.doneLines.01.text: Cots are set, Wren's flyers are out. Thanks, Matthew. Door's always open.

npc.tessa.lines.01.speaker: tessa
npc.tessa.lines.01.text: Yo. Gear's stashed around Star City. Hoodie near the Star path, jacket by the rails.

npc.tessa.lines.02.speaker: tessa
npc.tessa.lines.02.text: Street rumor: a rideshare keeps circling Jefferson right before a shop catches fire.

npc.tessa.lines.03.speaker: tessa
npc.tessa.lines.03.text: Collect the gear. Stay out of the rain. And don't trust anyone in a Boone Holdings jacket.

npc.tessa.doneLines.01.speaker: tessa
npc.tessa.doneLines.01.text: Stuff's stashed all over town — check the far ends of every street. Some fits, some just cool junk. Go get 'em.

npc.coach.lines.02.speaker: coach
npc.coach.lines.02.text: Boone's people burned the pharmacy on Campbell. Somebody has to carry it.

npc.coach.lines.03.speaker: coach
npc.coach.lines.03.text: Keep your feet moving. Trouble hates a moving target.

npc.coach.activeLines.01.speaker: coach
npc.coach.activeLines.01.text: Package goes to the River Bridge — right past the Rail Yards. Move those feet!

npc.coach.doneLines.01.speaker: coach
npc.coach.doneLines.01.text: Delivered on time? Knew you had hustle. Gym's open whenever.

npc.cam.lines.01.speaker: cam
npc.cam.lines.01.text: Need a lift? Wait. Wrong pin again. A woman named Vera Lisk keeps sending me the wrong pins.

npc.cam.lines.02.speaker: cam
npc.cam.lines.02.text: She has photos of my brother's bad night. Says she'll mail them to his boss unless I drive where she says.

npc.cam.lines.04.speaker: cam
npc.cam.lines.04.text: Every pin lands on a shop that burns the next day. I'm done driving for her, Matthew. Tell the right people.

npc.cam.doneLines.01.speaker: cam
npc.cam.doneLines.01.text: Last pin Vera sent says Mill Mountain, midnight. I'm not going. You shouldn't either. But you will, huh?

npc.wren.doneLines.01.speaker: wren
npc.wren.doneLines.01.text: Purse is back, petals are fine. You came up that mountain for me. You're a good egg, Matthew.

npc.silas.lines.03.speaker: silas
npc.silas.lines.03.text: She's in the switch house. Quite safe, for now.

npc.silas.lines.04.speaker: silas
npc.silas.lines.04.text: At midnight the Star goes out. When it comes back on, Roanoke answers to Boone Holdings. Walk away, or stand in the dark with her.

npc.silas.waitLines.02.speaker: silas
npc.silas.waitLines.02.text: Matthew Rose. Lovely rain. Go home. We'll talk properly once you've done a little more homework.

npc.silas.doneLines.01.speaker: silas
npc.silas.doneLines.01.text: The lights always come back on, Matthew. So do I.

npc.ellis.lines.01.speaker: ellis
npc.ellis.lines.01.text: Visitor badge, please. Matthew Rose? Huh. Half this building knows your name. The other half wishes they didn't.

npc.ellis.lines.02.speaker: ellis
npc.ellis.lines.02.text: Visiting hours run till the lights flicker twice. Cell Block C is through the right door. Mess hall, library, workshop and the yard after that.

npc.ellis.lines.03.speaker: ellis
npc.ellis.lines.03.text: No contraband, no fighting, no feeding the yard pigeons. And if you're here for Boone: C-14. He's been expecting you.

npc.ramos.lines.01.speaker: ramos
npc.ramos.lines.01.text: Cell Block C. Two tiers, ninety-six bunks and one man who still irons his blues.

npc.ramos.lines.02.speaker: ramos
npc.ramos.lines.02.text: I worked the Rail Yards beat before this job. Didn't take a dime from Boone trucks. Got moved out here for it. Funny how it worked out.

npc.ramos.lines.03.speaker: ramos
npc.ramos.lines.03.text: Boone's at the far end, C-14. Keep your hands where I can see them and you'll be fine.

npc.quay.lines.01.speaker: quay
npc.quay.lines.01.text: Twenty-two years in Block C. Long enough to tell a man's footsteps from the end of the hall. Yours are new.

npc.quay.lines.02.speaker: quay
npc.quay.lines.02.text: Boone came in like he owned the place. Asked the guards to call him Mister. They didn't.

npc.quay.lines.03.speaker: quay
npc.quay.lines.03.text: He reads every night. Same old newspaper, folded soft as cloth. Library's got the rest of that stack, if you're curious.

npc.reed.lines.01.speaker: reed
npc.reed.lines.01.text: Painted a star on the River Bridge pier. Wrong wall, wrong night. Eight months.

npc.reed.lines.02.speaker: reed
npc.reed.lines.02.text: You know Wren? Flower lady? She used to slip me zinnias to sketch. Tell her the drawings are getting good.

npc.reed.lines.03.speaker: reed
npc.reed.lines.03.text: Boone's guys tried to recruit me to tag 'final notice' on shop doors. I said no. Best bad decision I ever made.

npc.mina.lines.01.speaker: mina
npc.mina.lines.01.text: I carried envelopes for Vera Lisk. Never opened one. Turns out that doesn't count for much in court.

npc.mina.lines.02.speaker: mina
npc.mina.lines.02.text: Cam Ortiz testified. Brave guy. He looked at me like he was sorry I got caught in it. I'm sorry too.

npc.mina.lines.03.speaker: mina
npc.mina.lines.03.text: Vera's files? Never found. She said once that paper burns but people remember. I think she meant it as a warning.

npc.dora.lines.02.speaker: dora
npc.dora.lines.02.text: The Foreman's ledger, the one with Wren's name? I'm the one who told the prosecutors where to look. I sleep a little better now.

npc.otto.lines.01.speaker: otto
npc.otto.lines.01.text: I ran the Foreman's tool truck. Gas cans, crowbars, all of it. I'm not proud. Just honest now.

npc.otto.lines.02.speaker: otto
npc.otto.lines.02.text: Building birdhouses for the Community Center. June Whitaker sent the plans. Said every block needs somewhere soft to land.

npc.otto.lines.03.speaker: otto
npc.otto.lines.03.text: Mort Kessler, the Foreman, he's in the other wing. Won't come to shop class. Says hammers are beneath him. Ha.

npc.bart.lines.01.speaker: bart
npc.bart.lines.01.text: I wore a badge in the Rail Yards. I waved the Boone trucks through. Took the envelope every Friday.

npc.bart.lines.02.speaker: bart
npc.bart.lines.02.text: Hank Pettigrew's notes put me here. Old man wrote down every plate number for two years. I'd shake his hand if he'd let me.

npc.bart.lines.03.speaker: bart
npc.bart.lines.03.text: Sergeant Reyes cuffed Boone on the mountain. She's the real thing. The city's lucky some of us never took the money.

npc.silas_prison.lines.01.speaker: silas_prison
npc.silas_prison.lines.01.text: Matthew Rose. Visiting hours. How thoughtful.

mission.side_diner.offer.01.speaker: dee
mission.side_diner.offer.01.text: Matthew, before you head to Priya's: trouble. The Foreman's crew burned the hardware store last week. Tonight they're coming for my diner.

mission.side_diner.offer.02.speaker: dee
mission.side_diner.offer.02.text: They've got gas cans and a 'final notice' from Boone Holdings. Keep them off my door for three rounds and the apron's yours.

mission.side_diner.active.01.speaker: dee
mission.side_diner.active.01.text: Keep 'em off my door! Hit the ones with the cans first!

mission.side_snatch.offer.01.speaker: wren
mission.side_snatch.offer.01.text: Hey! HEY! That guy in the orange just grabbed my purse off the flower cart! My Boone Holdings receipts are in there!

mission.side_snatch.offer.02.speaker: wren
mission.side_snatch.offer.02.text: He's heading east toward the diner. He gets winded every few seconds. Catch him and land one hit!

mission.side_snatch.active.01.speaker: wren
mission.side_snatch.active.01.text: He went that way — east! Go go go!

mission.side_skate.offer.01.speaker: tessa
mission.side_skate.offer.01.text: Okay so. I posted a video of Boone's guys hanging around the shop. It got a LOT of views.

mission.side_skate.offer.02.speaker: tessa
mission.side_skate.offer.02.text: Now a whole crew's rolling up in the rain. Hold the bowl for forty seconds and they'll back off. Probably.

mission.side_skate.active.01.speaker: tessa
mission.side_skate.active.01.text: Just stay standing! Forty seconds! You got this!

mission.side_potluck.offer.01.speaker: june
mission.side_potluck.offer.01.text: Matthew! Families who lost their shops to the fires are sleeping here tonight, and I am three things short.

mission.side_potluck.offer.02.speaker: june
mission.side_potluck.offer.02.text: Dee promised a pie, Priya's lending books for the kids, and Tessa has string lights so it isn't so dark. Could you fetch them?

mission.side_potluck.active.01.speaker: june
mission.side_potluck.active.01.text: Pie from Dee, books from Priya, lights from Tessa. Then back to me, hon.

mission.side_potluck.item_pie.speaker: dee
mission.side_potluck.item_pie.text: One peach pie for June. Hold it level, Matthew — LEVEL.

mission.side_potluck.item_books.speaker: priya
mission.side_potluck.item_books.text: A box of large-print mysteries for the reading corner. Tell June the third one has a twist.

mission.side_potluck.item_lights.speaker: tessa
mission.side_potluck.item_lights.text: String lights! I only tangled them a little. Okay, a lot.

mission.side_spar.offer.01.speaker: coach
mission.side_spar.offer.01.text: Delivery was quick. But can you take a punch? Better question — can you NOT take one?

mission.side_spar.offer.02.speaker: coach
mission.side_spar.offer.02.text: Six sparring partners, light gloves. Get tagged too many times and we start over. Win, and the old varsity jacket's yours.

mission.side_spar.active.01.speaker: coach
mission.side_spar.active.01.text: Hands up! Move your feet! Don't get tagged!

mission.side_night.offer.01.speaker: hank
mission.side_night.offer.01.text: I'm telling the state inspector about those patrol cars. He's waiting at the River Bridge, away from local badges.

mission.side_night.offer.02.speaker: hank
mission.side_night.offer.02.text: These knees don't move fast, and Boone's people know my face. Walk me down to the bridge and keep them off me.

mission.side_night.active.01.speaker: hank
mission.side_night.active.01.text: Easy, kid. Bridge is past the yards, to the right. I'm right behind you.

mission.side_marcus_pages.item_page_priy.speaker: priya
mission.side_marcus_pages.item_page_priy.text: A page of times and initials. One says 'S.B.' a lot. Old pages, too. 2015.

mission.side_marcus_pages.item_page_hank.speaker: hank
mission.side_marcus_pages.item_page_hank.text: Bridge log. Same careful hand as the rail yard gate sheets, way back.

mission.side_marcus_pages.item_page_dee.speaker: dee
mission.side_marcus_pages.item_page_dee.text: Coffee ring on it. That's mine, sorry, hon.

main.linesFor.fetch_done.speaker: june
main.linesFor.fetch_done.text: You found everything! Matthew, this potluck is going to be perfect.

main.linesFor.busy.dee.speaker: dee
main.linesFor.busy.dee.text: Looks like you've got your hands full. Finish that first, then come see me.

main.linesFor.busy.wren.speaker: wren
main.linesFor.busy.wren.text: Looks like you've got your hands full. Finish that first, then come see me.

main.linesFor.busy.tessa.speaker: tessa
main.linesFor.busy.tessa.text: Looks like you've got your hands full. Finish that first, then come see me.

main.linesFor.busy.june.speaker: june
main.linesFor.busy.june.text: Looks like you've got your hands full. Finish that first, then come see me.

main.linesFor.busy.coach.speaker: coach
main.linesFor.busy.coach.text: Looks like you've got your hands full. Finish that first, then come see me.

main.linesFor.busy.hank.speaker: hank
main.linesFor.busy.hank.text: Looks like you've got your hands full. Finish that first, then come see me.

main.linesFor.busy.marcus.speaker: marcus
main.linesFor.busy.marcus.text: Looks like you've got your hands full. Finish that first, then come see me.

dlc.m1.s0.01.speaker: lou
dlc.m1.s0.01.text: Evening, Mr. Boone. Paper's late. So's everybody else tonight.

dlc.m1.s0.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m1.s0.02.text: Lou. Who's the new crew leaning on your stand?

dlc.m1.s0.03.speaker: lou
dlc.m1.s0.03.text: Calls themselves the Foreman's boys. Want 'rent' for the corner, or the stand catches fire. Here they come now.

dlc.m1.s0.04.speaker: silas
dlc.m1.s0.04.text: Then let's have a polite word with them. Watch the technique, Lou.

dlc.m1.s3.01.speaker: lou
dlc.m1.s3.01.text: Didn't know a coat that nice could move like that. Thank you, Mr. Boone. Truly.

dlc.m1.s3.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m1.s3.02.text: Everyone has something in them, Lou. The trick is knowing what.

dlc.m1.s3.03.speaker: lou
dlc.m1.s3.03.text: You'd run this street better than the Foreman ever could. Folks would pay you to keep them safe.

dlc.m1.s3.04.speaker: silas
dlc.m1.s3.04.text: Would they, now. Pay me. I'd never thought of it that way.

dlc.m1.s3.05.speaker: lou
dlc.m1.s3.05.text: Word is the Foreman lends money to half the shops. The courier at Valley Pages carries his list.

dlc.m2.s0.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m2.s0.02.text: Then I'm early for tomorrow. The Foreman's boys will come here next. I could keep them away. For a small monthly fee.

dlc.m2.s0.03.speaker: priya
dlc.m2.s0.03.text: That's the same thing they offer. You just say it nicer.

dlc.m2.s0.04.speaker: silas
dlc.m2.s0.04.text: Of course. I only ever offer.

dlc.m2.s0.05.speaker: priya
dlc.m2.s0.05.text: And that is exactly what worries me. Good night, Mr. Boone.

dlc.m2.s2.01.speaker: ivy
dlc.m2.s2.01.text: They grabbed my clipboard! It's the Foreman's collection list. Every shop that owes him.

dlc.m2.s2.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m2.s2.02.text: And here it is, back in your hands. Mostly.

dlc.m2.s2.03.speaker: ivy
dlc.m2.s2.03.text: Wait… the page with all the names is missing.

dlc.m2.s2.04.speaker: silas
dlc.m2.s2.04.text: Pages go missing in this town. His freight comes through the Rail Yards… second shift, wasn't it?

dlc.m2.s2.05.speaker: ivy
dlc.m2.s2.05.text: How did you — never mind. I didn't say anything.

dlc.m3.s0.01.speaker: gus
dlc.m3.s0.01.text: New on nights. They said a man in a long coat might come by.

dlc.m3.s0.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m3.s0.02.text: They were right. Who's moving freight at this hour, and who's letting them?

dlc.m3.s0.03.speaker: gus
dlc.m3.s0.03.text: The Foreman's outfit. Two patrol cars park by the gate and look the other way. Listen —

dlc.m3.s0.04.speaker: silas
dlc.m3.s0.04.text: I hear it. Stay behind the switch house, Gus.

dlc.m3.s2.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m3.s2.02.text: A badge is just a man with a price, Gus. Now they look the other way for me.

dlc.m3.s2.05.speaker: gus
dlc.m3.s2.05.text: Every night-shift lantern gets initials. What do I paint on yours?

dlc.m3.s2.07.speaker: gus
dlc.m3.s2.07.text: 'S.B. — 2nd shift.' There you go. Mind the bridge, somebody's been signaling from it.

dlc.m4.s1.01.speaker: vera
dlc.m4.s1.01.text: That lamp's for my friends, Mr. Boone. I keep files on everyone in this town. Even you.

dlc.m4.s1.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m4.s1.02.text: Then you know I'm worth listening to. Shall we discuss it?

dlc.m4.s1.03.speaker: vera
dlc.m4.s1.03.text: The Foreman said you talk too much.

dlc.m4.s1.04.speaker: silas
dlc.m4.s1.04.text: The Foreman is right more often than he knows.

dlc.m5.s1.01.speaker: foreman
dlc.m5.s1.01.text: Boone. You took my list, my cops and my lieutenant in one night.

dlc.m5.s1.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m5.s1.02.text: And you've been answering my questions, Mr. Kessler. Mostly with your fists.

dlc.m5.s3.01.speaker: foreman
dlc.m5.s3.01.text: Who do you even work for?

dlc.m5.s3.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m5.s3.02.text: As of tonight, Mr. Kessler, you work for me. Keep the whistle. Keep the matches, too.

dlc.m5.s3.05.speaker: silas
dlc.m5.s3.05.text: Look at it. The whole city looks up at that Star. One day they'll look up and think of me.

dlc.m6.s0.01.speaker: pip
dlc.m6.s0.01.text: Package for you, Mr. Boone. The papers from the city office. No questions, like you said.

dlc.m6.s0.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m6.s0.02.text: Questions are my department, Pip. Off you go.

dlc.m6.s2.04.speaker: silas
dlc.m6.s2.04.text: Then someone should buy up her debts. Someone kind.

dlc.m6.s3.01.speaker: silas
dlc.m6.s3.01.text: Boone Holdings. Lending, property, protection. Very fair terms.

dlc.m6.s3.02.speaker: silas
dlc.m6.s3.02.text: The Foreman's ledger goes in the folder… and every name in it now owes me.

dlc.idle.ivy.01.speaker: ivy
dlc.idle.ivy.01.text: I just deliver things. I don't read them. Not anymore.

dlc.idle.cam.01.speaker: cam
dlc.idle.cam.01.text: App keeps sending me to the wrong pin. Need a ride, sir?

dlc.idle.cam.02.speaker: silas
dlc.idle.cam.02.text: Not tonight. I like it right here.

prison.arrest.01.speaker: reyes
prison.arrest.01.text: Roanoke Police! Nobody move. Matthew Rose? Stay where you are, son. You've done enough for one night.

prison.arrest.02.speaker: reyes
prison.arrest.02.text: Silas Boone, you're under arrest for kidnapping, arson, extortion and bribing officers of this city. The ones on your payroll are already in the back of a van.

prison.arrest.03.speaker: okafor
prison.arrest.03.text: Hands behind your back, Mr. Boone. Slowly.

prison.arrest.04.speaker: silas
prison.arrest.04.text: No need for the bracelets, officer. I always walk out on my own two feet.

prison.arrest.06.speaker: reyes
prison.arrest.06.text: Hank Pettigrew's notes. Priya's list. Cam's pins. Tessa's video. Every name you buried, Boone. This city kept the receipts.

prison.arrest.08.speaker: silas
prison.arrest.08.text: Matthew. Enjoy the light while it lasts.

prison.arrest.09.speaker: reyes
prison.arrest.09.text: Take him down the mountain, Ben. And somebody get Miss Calloway a blanket.

prison.silas.start.01.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.start.01.text: Matthew Rose. Visiting hours. How thoughtful. Forgive the decor; the previous tenant had no taste either.

prison.silas.start.02.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.start.02.text: They gave me the blues, a cot and a window that looks at a wall. I've had worse offices.

prison.choice.regret.speaker: matthew
prison.choice.regret.text: Do you regret any of it?

prison.choice.paper.speaker: matthew
prison.choice.paper.text: I found an old newspaper in the library.

prison.silas.why.01.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.why.01.text: Why. Everyone asks why, as if the answer would fit on a postcard.

prison.silas.why.03.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.why.03.text: So I learned the rules: everyone owes someone. I just made sure, sooner or later, they all owed me.

prison.choice.wren.speaker: matthew
prison.choice.wren.text: Wren never owed you anything real.

prison.silas.wren.01.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.wren.01.text: No. She owed three loan sharks forty dollars apiece and she still gave flowers away for free.

prison.silas.wren.02.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.wren.02.text: I took her because you cared about her, Matthew. That was the mistake. People who care are very hard to buy.

prison.silas.wren.03.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.wren.03.text: Tell her... no. Tell her nothing. She's earned a quiet life.

prison.silas.vera.01.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.vera.01.text: Vera. Ah. The police turned the city upside down and found three empty filing cabinets and a very nice umbrella.

prison.silas.vera.02.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.vera.02.text: Vera Lisk never needed me, Matthew. She needed my secrets. I suspect she still has them.

prison.silas.vera.03.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.vera.03.text: If you see her, give her my regards. Then check your pockets.

prison.silas.regret.01.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.regret.01.text: Regret is a luxury for people with free time. I appear to have twenty-five years of it.

prison.silas.regret.02.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.regret.02.text: Do I regret the Star? No. For one minute the whole city looked up and thought of me.

prison.silas.regret.03.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.regret.03.text: Do I regret losing to a young man in a white polo? ...Ask me again in a few years.

prison.silas.paper.02.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.paper.02.text: The Foreman's boys came to collect 'rent' for Lou's corner. I had a polite word with them. The paper called me a good neighbor.

prison.silas.paper.04.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.paper.04.text: Keep it. Some stories are better told by someone else.

prison.silas.start_short.01.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.start_short.01.text: What else, Matthew? I'm not going anywhere.

prison.silas.bye.01.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.bye.01.text: Goodbye, Matthew Rose. Mind the rain on your way out.

prison.silas.bye.02.speaker: silas_prison
prison.silas.bye.02.text: And Matthew? The lights always come back on. Remember who turned them off.

bark.dee.dee_g1.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_g1.text: Morning, Matthew! Coffee's hot and the grill's hotter.

bark.dee.dee_g2.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_g2.text: There's my favorite regular. Booth's open, hon.

bark.dee.dee_g3.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_g3.text: Matthew! You eat today? Don't lie to me.

bark.dee.dee_i1.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_i1.text: Order up! ...Oh, that's just me talking to myself.

bark.dee.dee_i2.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_i2.text: Wren used to bring me zinnias for the counter.

bark.dee.dee_f1.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_f1.text: Go on, hon. Be careful out there.

bark.dee.dee_o1.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_o1.text: Ooh, new threads? Very downtown chic.

bark.dee.dee_o2.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_o2.text: Look at you! Spin around, let me see.

bark.dee.dee_o3.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_o3.text: Is that... a Boone suit? Take that off my floor.

bark.dee.dee_s1.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_s1.text: Priya keeps the list. Valley Pages, hon. Go.

bark.dee.dee_s2.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_s2.text: Heard you ran those boys off Campbell Ave. Thank you.

bark.dee.dee_s3.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_s3.text: The Star's back on. And Wren's home. Pie's free.

bark.dee.dee_w1.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_w1.text: Rain again? Come in before you drip on my floor.

bark.dee.dee_x1.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_x1.text: Not in front of my diner! ...Nice hook, though.

bark.dee.dee_l1.speaker: dee
bark.dee.dee_l1.text: You look rough, hon. Sit down, I'll fix you a plate.

bark.priya.pri_g1.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_g1.text: Matthew. Close the door behind you, please.

bark.priya.pri_g2.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_g2.text: Back already? I flagged three more names.

bark.priya.pri_g3.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_g3.text: Quiet voice, please. The walls have Boone ears.

bark.priya.pri_i1.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_i1.text: Eleven names. I keep counting like it'll change.

bark.priya.pri_i2.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_i2.text: Shelving mysteries. Feels a little on the nose.

bark.priya.pri_f1.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_f1.text: Watch the corners. Write down what you see.

bark.priya.pri_f2.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_f2.text: Go. And don't trust a badge tonight.

bark.priya.pri_o1.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_o1.text: New look? Good. Harder to recognize.

bark.priya.pri_o2.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_o2.text: That jacket has a whole backstory, I can tell.

bark.priya.pri_o3.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_o3.text: A Boone suit. That's... a choice, Matthew.

bark.priya.pri_s1.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_s1.text: Hank at the Rail Yards. He sees every truck.

bark.priya.pri_s2.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_s2.text: Names are coming off my list. One by one.

bark.priya.pri_w1.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_w1.text: Rain's good for business. Nobody wants to leave.

bark.priya.pri_x1.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_x1.text: I'm writing that down. All of it.

bark.priya.pri_l1.speaker: priya
bark.priya.pri_l1.text: You're bleeding on the poetry section. Sit.

bark.hank.hnk_g1.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_g1.text: Evening, kid. Mind the third rail.

bark.hank.hnk_g2.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_g2.text: You again. Good. I like company that listens.

bark.hank.hnk_g3.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_g3.text: Kid. Keep your voice down near the yard.

bark.hank.hnk_i1.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_i1.text: Forty years on these tracks. Never seen it this bad.

bark.hank.hnk_i2.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_i2.text: Hear that? Boone truck. Right on schedule.

bark.hank.hnk_f1.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_f1.text: Go on. Stay off the main road.

bark.hank.hnk_f2.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_f2.text: Watch for the patrol cars, kid.

bark.hank.hnk_o1.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_o1.text: New coat? Good. Nights get cold up here.

bark.hank.hnk_o2.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_o2.text: Ha. You look like a brakeman's nephew.

bark.hank.hnk_o3.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_o3.text: Boone's suit? Kid, they'll shoot first.

bark.hank.hnk_s1.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_s1.text: Midnight, kid. The Star. Don't be late.

bark.hank.hnk_s2.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_s2.text: State inspector's got my notes now.

bark.hank.hnk_s3.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_s3.text: Star's lit. Best thing I've seen in years.

bark.hank.hnk_w1.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_w1.text: Six days of rain. Rails get slick, kid.

bark.hank.hnk_x1.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_x1.text: Hah! Like the old days at the roundhouse.

bark.hank.hnk_l1.speaker: hank
bark.hank.hnk_l1.text: You're limping, kid. Sit on that crate a spell.

bark.june.jun_g1.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_g1.text: Matthew! Come in, there's soup on.

bark.june.jun_g2.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_g2.text: Oh good, a friendly face. We need those.

bark.june.jun_g3.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_g3.text: Hey you. Door's always open here.

bark.june.jun_i1.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_i1.text: Forty cots, thirty-eight blankets. I'll figure it out.

bark.june.jun_i2.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_i2.text: Soft landings matter. I keep telling folks that.

bark.june.jun_f1.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_f1.text: Come back if the city feels too dark.

bark.june.jun_o1.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_o1.text: Love the new look! Very you.

bark.june.jun_o2.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_o2.text: Ooh, fancy. Want to model for the flyers?

bark.june.jun_o3.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_o3.text: That suit makes the kids nervous, Matthew.

bark.june.jun_s1.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_s1.text: Thanks for the cots. Folks slept well.

bark.june.jun_s3.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_s3.text: People are going home, Matthew. Home!

bark.june.jun_w1.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_w1.text: Rain again. Grab a towel by the door.

bark.june.jun_x1.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_x1.text: Everyone okay? Nobody's hurt? Okay. Breathe.

bark.june.jun_l1.speaker: june
bark.june.jun_l1.text: Sit down. First aid kit's right here.

bark.tessa.tes_g1.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_g1.text: Yo, Matthew! Watch this kickflip. ...Okay, almost.

bark.tessa.tes_g2.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_g2.text: Sup. Shop's dead but the vibes are alive.

bark.tessa.tes_g3.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_g3.text: Ayy, it's the guy! Wait, I forgot your name.

bark.tessa.tes_i1.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_i1.text: I could ollie that rail. I just choose not to.

bark.tessa.tes_i2.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_i2.text: Bearings need oil. Like, a lot of oil.

bark.tessa.tes_f2.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_f2.text: Peace. Don't trip on a curb.

bark.tessa.tes_o3.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_o3.text: Dude. You look like a supervillain. Sick.

bark.tessa.tes_s1.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_s1.text: My video's got like ten thousand views. Boone's done.

bark.tessa.tes_s2.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_s2.text: You found the gear! Told you it was out there.

bark.tessa.tes_w1.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_w1.text: Rain ruins grip tape. Rain ruins everything.

bark.tessa.tes_l1.speaker: tessa
bark.tessa.tes_l1.text: Bro, you look like you ate the pavement.

bark.coach.coa_g2.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_g2.text: There he is. You stretching? Stretch.

bark.coach.coa_g3.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_g3.text: Good to see you moving, kid.

bark.coach.coa_i1.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_i1.text: Twenty more. Come on. ...I'm talking to myself.

bark.coach.coa_i2.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_i2.text: Hydrate. I don't care who you are. Hydrate.

bark.coach.coa_o1.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_o1.text: New gear? Looks fast. Prove it.

bark.coach.coa_o2.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_o2.text: Nice. Can you throw a hook in that?

bark.coach.coa_o3.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_o3.text: A suit's no good in a clinch, kid.

bark.coach.coa_s1.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_s1.text: Medicine made it. Knew you had hustle.

bark.coach.coa_s2.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_s2.text: Good spar. You drop that left hand, though.

bark.coach.coa_w1.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_w1.text: Rain's just free cardio. Keep going.

bark.coach.coa_l1.speaker: coach
bark.coach.coa_l1.text: You're gassed. Breathe in through the nose.

bark.cam.cam_g1.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_g1.text: Need a lift? Kidding. My car's a crime scene.

bark.cam.cam_g2.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_g2.text: Hey, Matthew. Phone hasn't buzzed in an hour.

bark.cam.cam_g3.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_g3.text: Oh, it's you. Good. I thought it was Vera.

bark.cam.cam_i1.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_i1.text: Four-point-nine stars. Ruined by one bad pin.

bark.cam.cam_i2.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_i2.text: I keep checking the mirror. Habit now.

bark.cam.cam_f1.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_f1.text: Stay safe. Don't take any wrong pins.

bark.cam.cam_f2.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_f2.text: Later. Tell the right people, okay?

bark.cam.cam_o1.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_o1.text: New look? You'd get five stars in that.

bark.cam.cam_o3.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_o3.text: Is that Boone's suit? Please don't.

bark.cam.cam_s1.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_s1.text: I'm out. No more pins. Thanks to you.

bark.cam.cam_s2.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_s2.text: Vera's phone went quiet. Best sound ever.

bark.cam.cam_w1.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_w1.text: Surge pricing in the rain. Not tonight.

bark.cam.cam_x1.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_x1.text: Okay. I did not see that. Or I did. Wow.

bark.cam.cam_l1.speaker: cam
bark.cam.cam_l1.text: Want me to drive you to urgent care?

bark.wren.wre_g1.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_g1.text: Matthew! Zinnias, two for five. For you, free.

bark.wren.wre_g2.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_g2.text: Hi! Smell these. No, really, smell them.

bark.wren.wre_i1.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_i1.text: Marigolds for luck. Daisies for no reason.

bark.wren.wre_i2.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_i2.text: The market smells like rain and petals.

bark.wren.wre_f1.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_f1.text: Bye! Come back before I close.

bark.wren.wre_f2.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_f2.text: Take a flower for the road!

bark.wren.wre_o1.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_o1.text: Ooh! That color needs a carnation.

bark.wren.wre_o3.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_o3.text: That suit. Matthew, I've seen it up close.

bark.wren.wre_s1.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_s1.text: You came up the mountain for me. I won't forget.

bark.wren.wre_s2.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_s2.text: My purse is back! Petals and all.

bark.wren.wre_w1.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_w1.text: Rain's good for the flowers. Bad for my hair.

bark.wren.wre_x1.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_x1.text: Matthew! Are you okay? Who were they?

bark.wren.wre_l1.speaker: wren
bark.wren.wre_l1.text: You're hurt! Here, sit by the cart.

bark.marcus.mar_g1.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_g1.text: Evening. Mind the grate, it bites ankles.

bark.marcus.mar_g2.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_g2.text: Matthew Rose. Crossed at 9:14 last Tuesday.

bark.marcus.mar_g3.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_g3.text: You again. I'll put you down as a regular.

bark.marcus.mar_i1.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_i1.text: Lamp glass won't polish itself. Mostly.

bark.marcus.mar_i2.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_i2.text: Near thirty years on this bridge. Still squeaks.

bark.marcus.mar_f1.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_f1.text: Go on. I'll log you out.

bark.marcus.mar_f2.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_f2.text: Watch the river side. Railing's loose.

bark.marcus.mar_o1.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_o1.text: New jacket. Noted. Everything gets noted.

bark.marcus.mar_o2.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_o2.text: That suit. I've seen it cross before. Long ago.

bark.marcus.mar_s1.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_s1.text: Coach's medicine made it across. Good work.

bark.marcus.mar_s2.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_s2.text: Star's lit again. Bridge looks better for it.

bark.marcus.mar_s3.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_s3.text: Lamps held all night. First time this month.

bark.marcus.mar_s4.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_s4.text: My pages, back in order. Thank you, Matthew.

bark.marcus.mar_s5.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_s5.text: Water's down. The bridge owes you one.

bark.marcus.mar_w1.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_w1.text: River's high. Six days of rain does that.

bark.marcus.mar_x1.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_x1.text: That's going in the book. Both sides.

bark.marcus.mar_l1.speaker: marcus
bark.marcus.mar_l1.text: Sit on the bollard a minute. Breathe.

bark.silas.sln_g1.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_g1.text: Evening, son. Kind of you to come all this way.

bark.silas.sln_g2.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_g2.text: Matthew Rose. Your mama know you're out?

bark.silas.sln_g3.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_g3.text: Come closer. I don't bite. Not first.

bark.silas.sln_i1.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_i1.text: Pretty view. Shame about the lights.

bark.silas.sln_i2.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_i2.text: Midnight's coming, son. It always does.

bark.silas.sln_f1.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_f1.text: Run along. The mountain will wait.

bark.silas.sln_o1.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_o1.text: Dressed up for me? I'm touched.

bark.silas.sln_o2.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_o2.text: My suit. Fits you poorly, son.

bark.silas.sln_w1.speaker: silas
bark.silas.sln_w1.text: Six days of rain. Washes a town clean.

bark.dlc_dee.dd_g1.speaker: dlc_dee
bark.dlc_dee.dd_g1.text: Mr. Boone. Coffee's... on the house, I guess.

bark.dlc_dee.dd_g2.speaker: dlc_dee
bark.dlc_dee.dd_g2.text: Back again? I paid this month.

bark.dlc_dee.dd_f1.speaker: dlc_dee
bark.dlc_dee.dd_f1.text: Have a good night, Mr. Boone.

bark.dlc_priya.dp_g1.speaker: dlc_priya
bark.dlc_priya.dp_g1.text: We're closing. ...For you, I suppose not.

bark.dlc_priya.dp_g2.speaker: dlc_priya
bark.dlc_priya.dp_g2.text: Mr. Boone. Looking for anything in particular?

bark.dlc_priya.dp_f1.speaker: dlc_priya
bark.dlc_priya.dp_f1.text: Mind the step on your way out.

bark.dlc_cam.dc_g1.speaker: dlc_cam
bark.dlc_cam.dc_g1.text: Uh, hi. I'm off the clock. Really.

bark.dlc_cam.dc_g2.speaker: dlc_cam
bark.dlc_cam.dc_g2.text: Need a ride? I mean... no charge.

bark.dlc_cam.dc_f1.speaker: dlc_cam
bark.dlc_cam.dc_f1.text: Okay. Bye. Drive safe. I mean, walk safe.

bark.dlc_marcus.dm_g2.speaker: dlc_marcus
bark.dlc_marcus.dm_g2.text: Evening, Mr. Boone. Nice night for a walk.

bark.dlc_marcus.dm_f1.speaker: dlc_marcus
bark.dlc_marcus.dm_f1.text: Safe crossing. I'll write you down.

bark.lou.lou_g1.speaker: lou
bark.lou.lou_g1.text: Evening edition, Silas. Read all about you.

bark.lou.lou_g2.speaker: lou
bark.lou.lou_g2.text: Papers are wet, coffee's cold. Welcome.

bark.ivy.ivy_g1.speaker: ivy
bark.ivy.ivy_g1.text: Boone! I got your envelope. Mostly dry.

bark.ivy.ivy_g2.speaker: ivy
bark.ivy.ivy_g2.text: Make it quick, I'm double-parked. On a bike.

bark.ivy.ivy_f1.speaker: ivy
bark.ivy.ivy_f1.text: Later! I'm gone in sixty seconds.

bark.gus.gus_g1.speaker: gus
bark.gus.gus_g1.text: Mr. Boone. Ledger's right where you left it.

bark.gus.gus_g2.speaker: gus
bark.gus.gus_g2.text: Night shift. Just me and the forklifts.

bark.gus.gus_f1.speaker: gus
bark.gus.gus_f1.text: I didn't see you. Never do.

bark.pip.pip_g1.speaker: pip
bark.pip.pip_g1.text: Mister Boone! Got a job for me?

bark.pip.pip_g2.speaker: pip
bark.pip.pip_g2.text: I ran the whole way. Twice!

bark.pip.pip_f1.speaker: pip
bark.pip.pip_f1.text: Bye! I'll be fast, I promise!

bark.thug_slick.ts_sp1.speaker: thug_slick
bark.thug_slick.ts_sp1.text: Hey! You're on the wrong block, pal.

bark.thug_slick.ts_t1.speaker: thug_slick
bark.thug_slick.ts_t1.text: C'mon, hero. That all you got?

bark.thug_slick.ts_t2.speaker: thug_slick
bark.thug_slick.ts_t2.text: Nice shirt. Shame about the face.

bark.thug_slick.ts_k2.speaker: thug_slick
bark.thug_slick.ts_k2.text: I'm good. Just resting. On the street.

bark.thug_slick.ts_ko2.speaker: thug_slick
bark.thug_slick.ts_ko2.text: Okay, that one's on you, pal.

bark.thug_slick.ts_l1.speaker: thug_slick
bark.thug_slick.ts_l1.text: Forget this, I ain't paid enough!

bark.thug_hot.th_sp1.speaker: thug_hot
bark.thug_hot.th_sp1.text: That's him! Boone wants him gone!

bark.thug_hot.th_sp2.speaker: thug_hot
bark.thug_hot.th_sp2.text: Oi! You! Hold it right there!

bark.thug_hot.th_t1.speaker: thug_hot
bark.thug_hot.th_t1.text: I'm gonna fold you like a lawn chair!

bark.thug_hot.th_t2.speaker: thug_hot
bark.thug_hot.th_t2.text: Swing all you want. I'm still here!

bark.thug_hot.th_k2.speaker: thug_hot
bark.thug_hot.th_k2.text: Gimme a second... the sky's spinning.

bark.thug_grunt.tg_sp2.speaker: thug_grunt
bark.thug_grunt.tg_sp2.text: Boss said nobody walks through here.

bark.thug_grunt.tg_t1.speaker: thug_grunt
bark.thug_grunt.tg_t1.text: You hit like my grandma. She hits hard.

bark.thug_grunt.tg_l2.speaker: thug_grunt
bark.thug_grunt.tg_l2.text: Not worth it. Not for this pay.

bark.crew.cr_sp1.speaker: crew
bark.crew.cr_sp1.text: It's Boone! Foreman said he'd come.

bark.crew.cr_sp2.speaker: crew
bark.crew.cr_sp2.text: Fancy suit. Wrong yard, old man.

bark.crew.cr_t1.speaker: crew
bark.crew.cr_t1.text: Your money's no good here, Boone.

bark.crew.cr_t2.speaker: crew
bark.crew.cr_t2.text: The Foreman runs these docks now!

bark.crew.cr_h2.speaker: crew
bark.crew.cr_h2.text: Whoa, the old man's got hands!

bark.crew.cr_ko1.speaker: crew
bark.crew.cr_ko1.text: He took out Dale! Swarm him!

bark.silas_boss.sb_in1.speaker: silas_boss
bark.silas_boss.sb_in1.text: Evening, son. Let's settle this like gentlemen.

bark.silas_boss.sb_in2.speaker: silas_boss
bark.silas_boss.sb_in2.text: You climbed a mountain to lose. Admirable.

bark.silas_boss.sb_t1.speaker: silas_boss
bark.silas_boss.sb_t1.text: Manners, Matthew. Your mama raised you better.

bark.silas_boss.sb_t2.speaker: silas_boss
bark.silas_boss.sb_t2.text: I own this city. You're renting a sidewalk.

bark.silas_boss.sb_p1.speaker: silas_boss
bark.silas_boss.sb_p1.text: Well now. You do have some fight in you.

bark.silas_boss.sb_l1.speaker: silas_boss
bark.silas_boss.sb_l1.text: Rest a spell. This town was mine long before you.

bark.silas_boss.sb_d1.speaker: silas_boss
bark.silas_boss.sb_d1.text: Fine work... but Roanoke always remembers.

bark.silas_boss.sb_d2.speaker: silas_boss
bark.silas_boss.sb_d2.text: Well. Someone pass me my hat.

bark.vera.ve_in1.speaker: vera
bark.vera.ve_in1.text: Silas. I have a file on you, too.

bark.vera.ve_in2.speaker: vera
bark.vera.ve_in2.text: You want the lamp? Come and take it.

bark.vera.ve_t2.speaker: vera
bark.vera.ve_t2.text: I keep photos. You're not photogenic.

bark.vera.ve_t3.speaker: vera
bark.vera.ve_t3.text: Careful. I bruise, then I remember.

bark.vera.ve_p2.speaker: vera
bark.vera.ve_p2.text: You just made my list, Boone.

bark.vera.ve_l1.speaker: vera
bark.vera.ve_l1.text: Tired, Silas? Sit. Let's talk terms.

bark.vera.ve_d1.speaker: vera
bark.vera.ve_d1.text: Keep the lamp. I kept copies.

bark.foreman.fo_in2.speaker: foreman
bark.foreman.fo_in2.text: My yard. My rules. My crew.

bark.foreman.fo_t1.speaker: foreman
bark.foreman.fo_t1.text: I've lifted girders heavier than you.

bark.foreman.fo_t2.speaker: foreman
bark.foreman.fo_t2.text: Hard hats on, boys. Boone's here.

bark.foreman.fo_t3.speaker: foreman
bark.foreman.fo_t3.text: Fancy shoes don't grip on oil, Boone.

bark.foreman.fo_l1.speaker: foreman
bark.foreman.fo_l1.text: You're done, old man. Clock out.

bark.foreman.fo_d1.speaker: foreman
bark.foreman.fo_d1.text: Fine... the yard's yours... for now.

vo_matthew_young_dlc1_m1_kid_l01.speaker: matthew_young
vo_matthew_young_dlc1_m1_kid_l01.text: That was— you just— they ran.

vo_silas_dlc1_m1_kid_l04.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m1_kid_l04.text: Go home, Matthew Rose. Nights belong to men like them. For now.
vo_silas_dlc1_m1_kid_l04.delivery: kind, with a hint of plan

vo_silas_dlc1_m2_errand_l02.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m2_errand_l02.text: Priya is right about most things. An errand, kid. Dee's Diner, the counter. Don't open it.

vo_matthew_young_dlc1_m2_errand_l03.speaker: matthew_young
vo_matthew_young_dlc1_m2_errand_l03.text: Ten bucks? For walking two blocks?

vo_vera_dlc1_m4_vera_after_l01.speaker: vera
vo_vera_dlc1_m4_vera_after_l01.text: Fine. Take the files. He's at the Star. Go and lose there.

vo_silas_dlc1_m4_vera_after_l02.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m4_vera_after_l02.text: Keep your files, Ms. Lisk. Keep making them. From tonight, you make them for me.

vo_silas_dlc1_m4_vera_after_l03.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m4_vera_after_l03.text: …My lantern. It went under the rail. Leave it. Lanterns are for being found.

vo_marcus_young_dlc1_m4_marcus_l01.speaker: marcus_young
vo_marcus_young_dlc1_m4_marcus_l01.text: Evening. The lady with the green lamp's been up here three nights running. I log her. Don't tell her.

vo_silas_dlc1_m4_marcus_l02.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m4_marcus_l02.text: Your secret is safe with me, Mr. …?

vo_marcus_young_dlc1_m4_marcus_l04.speaker: marcus_young
vo_marcus_young_dlc1_m4_marcus_l04.text: Quiet now. Lamps are lit. Whatever went under the rail can stay there.
vo_marcus_young_dlc1_m4_marcus_l04.delivery: after the fight; calm, hiding something

vo_matthew_young_dlc1_m6_quit_l01.speaker: matthew_young
vo_matthew_young_dlc1_m6_quit_l01.text: That's Wren's mom. You bought her loan?

vo_silas_dlc1_m6_quit_l02.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m6_quit_l02.text: I bought her time, kid. Someone kind had to.

vo_matthew_young_dlc1_m6_quit_l03.speaker: matthew_young
vo_matthew_young_dlc1_m6_quit_l03.text: Here's your money. All of it. I don't run your envelopes anymore.

vo_silas_dlc1_m6_quit_l04.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m6_quit_l04.text: Everyone runs my envelopes eventually. Do your homework, Matthew.
vo_silas_dlc1_m6_quit_l04.delivery: calm; the first crack of a grudge

vo_foreman_dlc1_finale_l01.speaker: foreman
vo_foreman_dlc1_finale_l01.text: Pharmacy on Campbell says it won't pay.

vo_silas_dlc1_finale_l02.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_finale_l02.text: Then write it down, Mr. Kessler. Everyone pays eventually. We're a patient company.

vo_silas_dlc1_finale_l03.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_finale_l03.text: This was Lou's corner. I stood here and kept it safe. Now I keep all of them.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_intro_l01.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_intro_l01.text: Bridge closes to foot traffic at two. You've got time.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_intro_l02.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_intro_l02.text: Crossed east Tuesday, nine-forty, with a bucket of zinnias. Didn't cross back. I write everybody down.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_intro_l03.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_intro_l03.text: Used to see you cross this bridge with envelopes. Sixteen, I'd guess. You stopped. Good.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_intro_l04.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_intro_l04.text: Lamps don't light themselves, and neither do people. Come back when you've got a minute. I could use a hand.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_idle_l01.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_idle_l01.text: Evening. Bridge is quiet. Find your friend first, son. The lamps will keep.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_idle_l02.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_idle_l02.text: Somebody's been signaling off this rail again. Green, this time of year.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_idle_l03.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_idle_l03.text: Some things you lock up and leave in the dark, Matthew. Until it's time.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l01.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l01.text: They want this bridge dark, so Boone trucks can cross without being counted. I've kept it lit near thirty years.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l02.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l02.text: Give me forty seconds. I'll mend the glass, you keep them off the rail.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l03.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l03.text: Forty seconds. Cracks hold better if you fill them. Keep them off me.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l04.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l04.text: Storm took my night logbook off the booth. Pages all over town.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l05.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l05.text: Priya, Hank and Dee each picked one up. Would you bring them back? Mind the torn one.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l06.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l06.text: Priya, Hank and Dee. Then back to the bridge.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l07.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l07.text: Every page. Thank you, Matthew. A man's memory is only as good as his paper.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l08.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l08.text: Flood gauge is down the Blackriver steps. My brother kept a boathouse down there.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l09.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l09.text: The Foreman's crew tails me whenever I go. Keep them busy while I read the water.

vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l10.speaker: marcus
vo_marcus_main_marcus_side_l10.text: Thirty-five seconds. Water's coming up fast tonight.

vo_silas_main_silas_history_l01.speaker: silas
vo_silas_main_silas_history_l01.text: Matthew Rose. Eleven years, and you still come when I call. You climbed a mountain in the rain to watch my city go dark.

vo_silas_main_silas_history_l02.speaker: silas
vo_silas_main_silas_history_l02.text: Every block that owed me, I collected. Wren owed a little more. Her mother's loan, kid. You carried the envelope.

vo_silas_main_silas_history_l03.speaker: silas
vo_silas_main_silas_history_l03.text: You quit on me once, at Dee's counter. I kept your ten dollars.

vo_silas_main_silas_history_l04.speaker: silas
vo_silas_main_silas_history_l04.text: I taught you to walk two blocks without opening an envelope, kid. Look what you opened.

vo_silas_main_silas_history_l05.speaker: silas
vo_silas_main_silas_history_l05.text: Eleven years ago I worked second shift in this city. I watched good people get pushed around by men who simply wanted more. I decided I would never be the one pushed.

vo_silas_main_silas_history_l06.speaker: silas
vo_silas_main_silas_history_l06.text: You were the only one who ever handed the money back, kid.

vo_silas_main_silas_history_l07.speaker: silas
vo_silas_main_silas_history_l07.text: Where did you... Lou Badger's newsstand. Jefferson Street. Spring of 2015. You were there, picking up your papers.

vo_silas_main_silas_history_l08.speaker: silas
vo_silas_main_silas_history_l08.text: Lou said folks would pay me to keep them safe. That was the night I started counting. I kept that clipping in my coat for eleven years, Matthew. Somewhere along the way I forgot why.

vo_dee_main_dee_history_l01.speaker: dee
vo_dee_main_dee_history_l01.text: Matthew. Sit down, hon. Your old booth. Wren never came back from closing her cart last night.

vo_dee_main_dee_history_l02.speaker: dee
vo_dee_main_dee_history_l02.text: She owed money to Boone Holdings, same as half this street. Same man who used to tip you twenty for a coffee run.

vo_priya_main_priya_history_l01.speaker: priya
vo_priya_main_priya_history_l01.text: Matthew. You got tall. Dee texted. Close the door. Here's my list: eleven people gone since spring.

vo_priya_main_priya_history_l02.speaker: priya
vo_priya_main_priya_history_l02.text: I told you at sixteen what that man was. I should've told everyone.

vo_hank_main_hank_history_l01.speaker: hank
vo_hank_main_hank_history_l01.text: Boone trucks roll through here every night, and two patrol cars wave them on. Eleven years they've been on his payroll, kid.

vo_hank_main_hank_history_l02.speaker: hank
vo_hank_main_hank_history_l02.text: I said no to his envelope once, back in 2015. Cost me my nights.

vo_coach_main_coach_history_l01.speaker: coach
vo_coach_main_coach_history_l01.text: Matthew! Need a courier who can hustle. Medicine for the folks camped by the River Bridge. Better than the errands you used to run, kid.

vo_cam_main_cam_history_l01.speaker: cam
vo_cam_main_cam_history_l01.text: She's had my plate since my first year driving. 2015. Said she never forgets a car.

vo_wren_main_wren_history_l01.speaker: wren
vo_wren_main_wren_history_l01.text: Matthew! Fresh zinnias, two for five. Boone's men came by again. Mom's loan never dies. Walk with me after close?

vo_mina_main_prison_seeds_l01.speaker: mina
vo_mina_main_prison_seeds_l01.text: I carried Vera's lamp the night she lost her first files. 2015. I was nineteen.

vo_dora_main_prison_seeds_l01.speaker: dora
vo_dora_main_prison_seeds_l01.text: Shh. Library voice. I kept the books for Boone Holdings for eleven years. Signed on the day it opened. Now I keep these. Better company.

vo_dora_main_prison_seeds_l02.speaker: dora
vo_dora_main_prison_seeds_l02.text: Someone donated a box of old Roanoke papers. Spring 2015. Check the return cart in the back. Silas keeps asking for one issue.

vo_dora_main_prison_seeds_l03.speaker: dora
vo_dora_main_prison_seeds_l03.text: The day the company opened, a boy was busing tables at Dee's. Silas watched him the whole time.

vo_otto_main_prison_seeds_l01.speaker: otto
vo_otto_main_prison_seeds_l01.text: I drove the Foreman's truck till the night Boone bought it. Same truck. New boss.

vo_bart_main_prison_seeds_l01.speaker: bart
vo_bart_main_prison_seeds_l01.text: I took Boone's first envelope in 2015. Second shift. Hank Pettigrew watched me take it.

vo_priya_dlc1_m2_offer_l01.speaker: priya
vo_priya_dlc1_m2_offer_l01.text: Mr. Boone. We're closed. Eyes on the page, Matthew.

vo_gus_dlc1_m3_yard_l01.speaker: gus
vo_gus_dlc1_m3_yard_l01.text: The crate's gone. And Officer Holley and his partner just drove off with an envelope. Yours?

vo_gus_dlc1_m3_yard_l02.speaker: gus
vo_gus_dlc1_m3_yard_l02.text: Hank Pettigrew from the day crew wouldn't touch your envelope. Said so to your face.

vo_silas_dlc1_m3_yard_l01.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m3_yard_l01.text: Then Hank can have the day shift. Nights are mine.

vo_otto_dlc1_m5_star_l01.speaker: otto
vo_otto_dlc1_m5_star_l01.text: Truck's still running, Mr. Boone. Who do I drive for now?

vo_silas_dlc1_m5_star_l01.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m5_star_l01.text: The winning side, Mr. Pike. It pays better.

vo_dora_dlc1_m6_books_l01.speaker: dora
vo_dora_dlc1_m6_books_l01.text: Dora Keene. I kept the books for Roanoke Mutual until it folded. I hear you're hiring.

vo_silas_dlc1_m6_books_l01.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m6_books_l01.text: I'm founding, Ms. Keene. Hiring comes after. Bring a pen.

vo_dee_dlc1_m6_counter_l01.speaker: dee
vo_dee_dlc1_m6_counter_l01.text: Evening! Table, or to-go? Matthew, table four.

vo_silas_dlc1_m6_counter_l01.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m6_counter_l01.text: Just a coffee. Busy street. Who runs the flower cart?

vo_dee_dlc1_m6_counter_l02.speaker: dee
vo_dee_dlc1_m6_counter_l02.text: Rosa Calloway. Her girl Wren helps after school. Rosa borrowed from the Foreman to keep that cart going. Poor thing owes everybody.

vo_silas_dlc1_m6_ledger_l01.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_m6_ledger_l01.text: Rosa Calloway. Lou Badger. Dee Morales. Let's see what a city does when it owes one man.

vo_matthew_young_dlc1_idle_l01.speaker: matthew_young
vo_matthew_young_dlc1_idle_l01.text: Mr. Boone tips better than anyone. Dee says that's how you know to worry.

vo_matthew_young_dlc1_idle_l02.speaker: matthew_young
vo_matthew_young_dlc1_idle_l02.text: I should get home. My mom worries.

vo_rosa_dlc1_idle_l01.speaker: rosa
vo_rosa_dlc1_idle_l01.text: Zinnias, two for five. Wren picked them. Don't tell her I said they're the best ones.

vo_dora_dlc1_idle_l01.speaker: dora
vo_dora_dlc1_idle_l01.text: Debits on the left, Mr. Boone. People on the right.

vo_mina_dlc1_idle_l01.speaker: mina
vo_mina_dlc1_idle_l01.text: Ms. Lisk dropped her bundle when she fell. I can't find it anywhere.

vo_silas_dlc1_idle_l01.speaker: silas
vo_silas_dlc1_idle_l01.text: Things go missing on bridges, Ms. Solis.

vo_bart_dlc1_idle_l01.speaker: bart
vo_bart_dlc1_idle_l01.text: Didn't see a thing, Mr. Boone. Never do on second shift.

vo_otto_dlc1_idle_l01.speaker: otto
vo_otto_dlc1_idle_l01.text: Same truck. New boss. That's all I know.

vo_marcus_young_dlc1_idle_l01.speaker: marcus_young
vo_marcus_young_dlc1_idle_l01.text: Mind the rail. It eats things.
